prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a unique editorial cover for a Home Assistant guide explaining scenes, scripts and automations through a dinner-lighting routine. Wide horizontal composition, 1536x1024. A quiet modest contemporary dining nook at dusk, oak table set for two with simple ceramic bowls, forest-green built-in bench and linen cushions, one understated pendant casting a gentle pool of warm light over the table, a small sideboard lamp glowing softly in the background. A visible simple wall light switch at the edge of the room makes manual control tangible. Focus on contrasting practical pools of light and a comfortable inhabited room, crisp materials, restrained magazine photography, believable proportions, no people. No identifiable branded smart-home hardware, no invented gadget, no screens, no text, no headline, no logo, no diagrams, no graphs, no routing lines, no glowing overlays, no translucent panels, no inset frames, no floating UI. This is conceptual editorial art, not a tested installation.
